_comment: kbli-client-facing-content-defects (ward-round 2026-08-07). Adjudicates the 4 contradicted-predecessor codes L2.1 left open (46415/46496/49296/64210, PENDING-ARMS line 610). For 49296 and 64210, the PP28/2025 lampiran title-match AND the independently-parsed official BPS 2020-to-2025 crosswalk table (Phase-0 gated, P=R=1.0 on holdout) name the SAME KBLI-2020 predecessor -- two structurally independent sources agreeing by membership, the same corroboration pattern already used for the Lampiran III cross-instrument check (2026-08-02). 46415 and 46496 genuinely disagree between the two sources and stay 'unconfirmed' -- this spec only re-aligns gold's SEPARATE (and, for 46496, stale-false-confident) wording to canonical's already-honest text; it does not touch the disagreement itself.
